title: AI for Weather Prediction for Africa (Project Umoya)
summary: Project Umoya plans to fine-tune GraphCast and Aurora with African weather data to improve local forecasts for climate-sensitive decisions.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Ishango.ai proposes fine-tuning GraphCast and Aurora using African weather datasets, including reanalysis and station observations. The intended benefit is more locally relevant forecasting for agriculture, energy, and weather services. Data acquisition and model validation remain in progress. Community training and networking support development.
purpose: Generate more locally relevant weather forecasts for African decision makers.

ratings.reason: More useful regional model forecasts are intended; no completed local forecast-performance improvement is reported.
Improved agricultural and climate resilience through better AI forecasts remains intended.

ai_role.statement: AI weather models would learn from regional observations and generate forecasts.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 12: AI for Weather Prediction for Africa (Project Umoya)

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: Project Umoya plans locally adapted African weather forecasts
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
